description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“Makin’ Memories,” a beautiful 4-suite retreat in the heart of Seacrest Beach. Steps from the famous Lagoon Pool and with a free tram ride to the beach, every moment is designed for relaxation and fun. Features include 6 beach cruiser bikes, spacious balconies, and a poker room with wet bar on the 3rd floor. Pet-friendly and perfect for families or groups of friends ready to create lasting memories. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Steps to Lagoon Pool: A short 3-minute walk to the famous 12,000 sq. ft. Lagoon pool deck.Free Tram to Beach: Enjoy convenient access to the beach with a complimentary tram (seasonally).Prime Location: 4-minute walk to boutique shopping, restaurants, and Peddler’s Pavilion.Spacious Design: 4 bedrooms with en-suites across 3 floors, accommodating up to 12 guests with plenty of room to relax.Outdoor Living: Large 3rd-floor deck, perfect for outdoor dining or enjoying the wooded views.Entertainment Features: Professional poker table and wet bar on the 3rd floor.Pet-Friendly: Bring your pup along (fees and restrictions apply).Included Bikes: 6 cruiser bikes provided for exploring Seacrest’s trails and nearby beaches.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:“AMAZING RENTAL. This place is AMAZING. Close to the pool, beach, market center, etc. Great stay.” – Mario W.“Everything was super clean, very nice, and close to everything! The house came with everything we needed and more. We will absolutely book again!” – Whitney H.“Perfect house even more beautiful in person. Walk to the pool, tram to the beach or bike to restaurants/ice cream. Would love to stay here again.” – Nichole S.*** YOUR PERFECT PLACE FOR MAKIN' MEMORIES ***Welcome to Makin' Memories, the ultimate vacation rental home in beautiful Seacrest Beach! Nestled perfectly between Rosemary and Alys, this luxurious 3-story, 4 en-suite home is designed to entertain. Whether you're lounging by the nearby pool, cruising to the beach, or exploring the vibrant local market centers, Makin' Memories offers the perfect setting to create unforgettable moments with your loved ones. Get ready to paint your favorite beach vacation memories on this stunning canvas!*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into a warm, thoughtfully designed open-concept living space on the first floor. With a blend of comfort and style, this area makes family time, relaxation, and entertaining a breeze.Open layout connecting living, dining, and kitchen.Cozy seating with a large TV for movie nights.Outdoor patio, perfect for coffee or evening chats.On the third floor, you'll find a wet bar and professional poker table—perfect for entertaining and unwinding. The expansive deck offers a peaceful retreat with a view of the natural wooded area behind the house.Wet bar for easy entertaining.Poker table seating 4, ideal for games or snacks.Covered deck for outdoor dining and lounging.Natural gas fire table with plush furnishings.*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Unleash your inner chef in the fully equipped kitchen while keeping your group connected at the large dining table. Meals here are bound to be special moments.Modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances and ample counter space.Dining table with seating for 6, bistro table for 4, plus breakfast bar seating for 4 more.*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Guest Bedroom with King-sized bed, natural wooded views, and private en-suite with a walk-in glass shower.Convenient Laundry Room on this level.2nd Floor:Primary Suite with King-sized bed, private balcony overlooking the wooded backyard, and luxurious en-suite with dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower.Guest Suite with King-sized bed, private balcony with neighborhood views, and en-suite with a walk-in shower.3rd Floor:Family Suite with King-sized bed and two twin bunk beds, perfect for kids or additional guests.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Situated between the renowned Rosemary and Alys Beach, "Makin’ Memories" is a charming retreat that perfectly combines relaxation and convenience in the lively Seacrest Beach community. Equipped with 6 beach bikes, it makes exploring the area both easy and enjoyable.Lagoon Pool – A 12,000 sq. ft. paradise just a 3-minute walk away, featuring a zero-entry splash zone, waterfalls, and plenty of loungers.Beach Access – Hop on the free seasonal tram for an easy ride to the beach, perfect for carrying gear.Peddler’s Pavilion – A 4-minute walk to boutique shops, live music, dining, and seasonal nightlife.Scenic Walking & Nature Trails – Enjoy picturesque trails just steps from the house, perfect for exploration and relaxation.Walkable, Bike-Friendly Community – Conveniently stroll to Rosemary Beach (14 minutes walk) or Alys Beach in (10 minutes walk) for a charming coastal experience.South Walton’s Tallest Sand Dunes – A unique feature of this stunning area.*** PET POLICY ***To ensure a clean and enjoyable experience for all guests, please note the following guidelines for pets:Pets are not allowed on furniture, beds, or in the pool.Dogs must be kept in a crate when guests are not present with them.A non-refundable pet fee of $250 + tax applies.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.This property has 6 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.There is an active Ring doorbell camera at the entrance door of the home.Pet-friendly with a non-refundable pet fee of $250 + tax.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 30376STRO #: STR-030376

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Essentials: Olive Oil and Salt & Pepper Starter Supplies
